court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Sau. Pranali W/O Rohit Wanjari vs Rohit @ Lakhan S/O Ashokrao Wanjari

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sau. Pranali w/o Rohit Wanjari, applicant
parties.respondent_defendant: Rohit @ Lakhan s/o Ashokrao Wanjari, non-applicant

facts_of_case: The applicant has filed proceedings for restitution of conjugal rights and maintenance before the Civil Judge, Senior Division, Hinganghat. The non-applicant has filed a petition for divorce before the Family Court, Nagpur.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a petition to another court if the applicant has made out a case for it.
legal_principles.held: Considering the above facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the considered view that the applicant - wife has made out a case for transfer of Petition No.A-192/2018 filed under Section 13(1)(i-a) of the Hindu Marriage Act, filed by non-applicant pending before the Family Court, Nagpur to the Court of Civil Judge, Senior Division, Hinganghat.

legal_principles.principle: The court may not apply Section 21-A of the Hindu Marriage Act in all cases.
legal_principles.held: From perusal of the provisions of Section 21-A, I am of the considered view that the said provision is not made applicable in the present case.

use_for_drafting: responding to non-applicant's petition for divorce
